note: Set A is internally clean — every wiring-schedule claim (marks 10, 20, 31, 32, 33, 34, 50, 150 and the AL feeder to the main service panel) is correctly bound and quoted — but it ignores the entire NOTES block, so it misses the 120/240V 1-phase 3-wire sub-panel, the 50A/2P main breaker, the 2.8kW inverter with ground fault, the 60A DC NFDS, the 200A/2P NFDS and the NEMA 3R junction box. Set B captures those equipment ratings and the sub-panel voltage in addition to the same wiring-schedule data, with only one clear defect: the Component 6 rating is misread as '200/2 A/P' instead of 200A/2P. B also duplicates some rows (Circuit/Wiring pairs), but its coverage of the page's key engineering facts outweighs A's omission of all equipment ratings.
